prerequisites: Having studied Physics in 2nd year of Bachillerato (high school)
Previous mathematical knowledge of vector calculus, trigonometry, and differentiation and integration of single-variable functions

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the concept of wave and know both its mathematical characterization and basic wave phenomena.
Know the basic concepts and laws of electromagnetism and apply them to the analysis of simple electromagnetic situations in vacuum and in material media.
Correctly handle the recommended physical symbology, both in terms of magnitudes and units.
Learn and apply problem-solving strategies related to the different contents of the course.
Acquire skills related to laboratory work and the treatment of measurements and errors.

syllabus_topics: Electrostática: Carga eléctrica. Ley de Coulomb. Campo y potencial electrostático. Distribuciones de carga. Dipolo eléctrico. Ley de Gauss. Conductores. Condensadores. Energía del campo eléctrico. Dieléctricos.
Corriente eléctrica: Intensidad y densidad de corriente eléctrica. Ley de Ohm. Resistencia. Efecto Joule. Generadores: Fuerza electromotriz. Circuitos de corriente continua.

Magnetostática: Campo magnético. Ley de Lorentz: Inducción magnética. Efecto Hall. Fuerza magnética sobre una corriente eléctrica. Momento del campo magnético sobre una espira. Ley de Biot-Savart. Fuerza entre corrientes. Teorema de Ampère. Energía del campo magnético. Magnetismo en la materia.
Campos electromagnéticos variables con el tiempo: Inducción electromagnética: Ley de Faraday-Henry. Autoinducción. Ecuaciones de Maxwell. Circuitos RLC. Oscilaciones eléctricas.
Oscilaciones: Oscilaciones libres. Oscilaciones amortiguadas. Oscilaciones forzadas.
Ondas: Generalidades. Ondas mecánicas: Concepto de onda. Ecuación diferencial de ondas. Clasificación de ondas. Ondas armónicas. Ondas mecánicas. Fenómenos ondulatorios. Efecto Doppler.
Práctica 1. Ley de Ohm / Circuitos de Corriente Continua.
Práctica 2. Carga del Condensador / Campo Magnético de un Solenoide.
Práctica 4. Ondas Mecánicas / Ondas Estacionarias en una Cuerda.
teaching_methods: Expository classes (exposition and explanation of theoretical contents, exemplification and problem-solving, group evaluation activities)
Classroom practices/seminars (problem-solving, group work activities, presentation and defense of problems/works/projects, small group evaluation activities)
Laboratory practices (handling lab equipment, using simulation/data processing software, analyzing results and writing practice reports, very small group evaluation activities)
Problem-solving and preparation of practice reports/works

assessment_methods.method: Partial Exam (T2) on remaining theoretical content
Practical work (P1) based on laboratory results submission

assessment_rules: For ordinary examination, if minimums for Partial Exam (T1) and Partial Exam (T2) are met, the theory grade is (0.35 x T1) + (0.40 x T2) + (0.10 x PA). If the minimum for Partial Exam (T1) is not met, the theory grade is (0.75 x ET) + (0.10 x PA). A minimum of 5/10 is required for T1, and 4/10 for T2 and ET. For the practical block, attendance to 75% of practical sessions is mandatory, and the grade is (0.08 x P1) + (0.07 x P2). The final grade is (Theory) + (Practices), provided theory minimums are met and 75% practical attendance is achieved, otherwise the final grade is the minimum between the calculated grade and 4.0. For the extraordinary examination, theory is (0.75 x ET) + (0.10 x PA) with a minimum of 4/10 for ET. Practical grades are maintained if 75% attendance was met, otherwise it's (0.15 x P2) with a minimum of 4/10 for P2.
